channel.title: AI Unfiltered
channel.description: Chinese AI • Open Source • Security • Incidents. Signal, not noise.

item.title: At the Embodied-AI Crossroads, WUWENAI Chose to Pave the Road
item.description: WUWENAI founder Liu Shengxiang bets that embodied AI's bottleneck is data. The startup built a closed-loop Real-to-Sim-to-Real pipeline that he says arrives months ahead of World Labs' SceniX move.

item.title: Westlake University's Yu Kaicheng Builds a Concept World Model and Speaks for the First Time
item.description: After a 100-million-yuan seed-plus-angel round, Awomo founder Yu Kaicheng makes his first public case for an implicit, concept-space world model that beats the data-driven scaling law he once helped write.

item.title: From Optical Modules to Optical Transport: Why AI Cannot Run Without China's Supply Chain
item.description: LightCounting ranks seven Chinese vendors in the global optical-module top ten. As 1.6T ramps, the focus is shifting from pluggable modules to optical transport, silicon photonics, InP substrates, and CPO.

item.title: China's Memory-Chip Decade: It's Not Only About the Winners
item.description: Jinhua and CXMT both started in 2016 to break the Samsung-SK Hynix-Micron DRAM hold. A US blacklist froze one on the eve of mass production, while the other just rang the bell at the A-share IPO.

item.title: Behind Liang Wenfeng's Viral 'Hard-Man' Memes, China's LLMs Are Becoming a Global Catfish
item.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash tops OpenRouter's weekly global token-usage ranking at 7.1 trillion tokens, with four of the top five slots now held by Chinese models, forcing OpenAI to cut GPT-5.6 Luna pricing by 80%.
